evidence.quote: Mid-16th century. Original meaning was somewhat idiomatic, meaning "to walk using snowshoes." Probably of Scandinavian origin, compare {{cog|is|þrúga||snowshoe}}, {{cog|no|truga||snowshoe}} and dialectal Swedish {{m|sv|trudja||snowshoe}}.
